wands.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / game texture extraction.
Input image 1: the user's approved three-panel concept board, exact weapon design reference. Input image 2: an existing finished 128px wand item texture, style / orientation / scale reference only.
Task: extract and faithfully redraw ONLY the specified staff from image 1 as one ready-to-export Minecraft item sprite. Keep its recognizable silhouette, faceted gems, trim, collars and pommel. Do NOT invent a different head design.
Composition: one isolated COMPLETE staff in a SQUARE canvas, rotated to the same 45-degree diagonal as the existing wand texture, pommel at lower left around (12%,88%), head at upper right around (82%,18%). A slender shaft connects both. Keep every pixel and point within a generous transparent margin of at least 7%. Staff extends across ~85% of canvas diagonal, head fills upper-right quadrant. No crops.
Style: deliberate high-quality pixel art, designed on a logical 128 by 128 grid, hard square pixels, thin clean dark outline, faceted gemstone shading with controlled highlight colors, ornate gold / metal trim readable at item scale. Same finished in-game pixel-sprite appearance as image 2. Not a smooth painting, not a 3D render, no antialiasing blur.
Background: actual RGBA transparency, completely empty around the object and in gaps/openings. Remove ALL card frames, medallion numbers, magic circles, temple, nebula, detached sparkles, floating shards, aura and decorative effects. Brightness comes from painted bright highlight pixels INSIDE the materials, not a translucent glow. No shadow, floor, text, letters, numbers, watermark, hands or other objects.
Keep only the physical weapon; attached small spikes are allowed. One sprite, not a sprite sheet or three-panel board.
Subject: ONLY staff 05, the LEFT emerald-and-gold dragon crown staff. Preserve layered branching gold spines around a dark emerald crown, taller faceted green crystals pointing along the shaft axis, white-green star-shaped highlight at the emerald heart, sculptural gold dragon-inspired collar / carved thorned socket, dark black-green slender shaft with gold grip rings, one small emerald on the lower shaft and a faceted emerald pommel framed in gold. Crown is jagged and irregular, luxurious and royal, not a tree or leafy branch. Reproduce the approved object itself while rotating it to 45 degrees.
